PROCEDURE AND SURGEON
Left shoulder examination under anesthesia and arthroscopy. Surgeon: David Capiola, M.D.
PROCEDURE PERFORMED
Posterior labral repair with a 2.99 mm BioComposite PushLock anchor and a cinch stitch; complete synovectomy; lysis of
adhesions; subacromial decompression; debridement of the biceps tendon, partial rotator cuff tear and cartilage defect.
POST-OPERATIVE DIAGNOSIS
Significant posterior labral tear, synovitis, adhesions, impingement, biceps tendon partial tear, partial rotator cuff tear,
cartilage defect.
